### 🎯 Hardpoint — a zone that keeps moving
- New PvP mode in two flavours: **Hardpoint** (teams) and **Hardpoint FFA** (everyone for themselves).
- Hold the live zone to bank points — 2 per second, and only while nobody else is standing in it.
- The zone jumps to another spot every 40 seconds, so no team can camp one corner for a whole match.
- The HUD tells you whether the point is open, held or contested, and the live zone is drawn on the minimap at its real size.
- Maps need at least three zones placed in the editor to offer the mode.

### 🏷️ Kill Confirmed
- New free-for-all mode: a kill only scores once someone picks up the dog tag the victim drops.
- Stand on an enemy tag for 1.5 s to confirm the kill — or grab your own to **deny** it and wipe the kill off the board.
- Untaken tags expire after 30 seconds, and start blinking as time runs out.
- The scoreboard and end-of-match stats now track confirms and denies.

### 🔍 Scavenge — a match with no shop
- New economy option in the lobby: no buy menu at all. You spawn with a knife and everything else lies on the arena floor.
- Guns, grenades and medkits sit at spots the map author placed. An item nobody takes disappears after ~45 s and a new one turns up ~25 s later, so the good spots stay worth walking to all match.
- Weapon spawns can be tuned per point — any gun, rifles, snipers, special weapons, pistols & SMG, grenades & gear, or healing.

### 🚫 Banned weapons and gear
- New **Advanced settings** in the lobby: the room founder can strike any weapon or gear item off the match.
- A banned item can't be bought, nobody spawns with it, and it never turns up on the floor in Scavenge.
- The knife and the pistol can't be banned — every respawn falls back to them.
- The knife is now buyable in the shop, so you're no longer stuck without a blade after dropping yours.

### 🔥 Molotov
- A fourth throwable, in the shop and craftable in survival. It breaks on the ground and leaves a pool of fire burning for 7 seconds.
- Nothing dies to the throw itself — the fire does 26 damage a second to anything standing in it, so it's for taking a doorway, a stairwell or a flag away from someone.
- It bounces off walls and trunks and only bursts when it lands on something flat, so it burns where you put it.
- Fires are lit, crackle, and show up in the kill feed as their own cause of death.

### 🤾 Throwing, reworked
- Grenades are now **hold and release** on both buttons — press to pull your arm back, hold as long as you need to line the arc up, let go to throw. Left mouse is the full overhand throw, right mouse the short lob.
- Holding does *not* shorten the fuse: your victims always get the same warning.
- Other players now visibly wind up and throw, instead of a grenade appearing out of nowhere.

### ⛈️ Recorded thunder
- Storms now use real thunder recordings — a close crack and a distant rumble, several takes each, so a storm never repeats itself.
- Distant strikes arrive up to 2.6 s after the flash, which is what makes a storm feel like it has a distance.

### ✨ Fixes and polish
- Smoke grenades no longer show every tree's and rock's shading through the cloud.
- Wooden fences now block shots only where they're actually solid — you can shoot over and between the pickets.
- Painted grass on PvP maps fades down with distance instead of appearing at a hard ring, which also gives back some frame rate on grassy maps.
- Respawning and the round-start countdown no longer draw you at the wrong spot and snap you to the real one.
- The shotgun is held closer to the eye in first person.
- New survival recipes: split a log into sticks, bone arrows, sniper and grenade-launcher rounds, and fuel rendered from rotten flesh.
